chat.t: You coming to Vermont tomorrow?
Since you'll be in town, stop by Bloody Mary.

o: Tomorrow? I'm not planning to go to Vermont.

chat.t: Then find an excuse and get over here.

o: Why? It's not exactly close.

chat.t: Then take a job around here or something.

o: If I could pick and choose my jobs, I wouldn't be living like this.

chat.t: Fair point.
Then I'll hire you.
Come to Bloody Mary right now.

o: Fine. Just make sure you have my pay ready.

chat.t: You sure run fast.

o: To survive in this business, you gotta be quick on your feet.

chat.t: Yeah, yeah. So, how was the chair? Ready to become my subject?

o: After all that running? Not a chance.

chat.t: Is that so?
Then I'll have to find another way.

o: Do whatever you want. Just please don't cause any trouble.

chat.t: Well, since you put it that way, I'll consider it.

lines.t: Bloody Mary
What on earth is going on here...?
Why is everyone stumbling around under a charm spell?
Oh, you're here! I've been waiting for you.
You mean this? A few fools were drinking and causing a scene.
I was merely giving them a quick lesson in manners.
That chair looks pretty comfy. Mind if I sit in it for a bit?
Hands off—it's mine.
So stingy! It's not like sitting in it will wear it out.
Don't go using someone else's guest as a chair like that.

Tch... Like you're any better.
Anyway, what job did you drag me all the way here for?
If you called me here for nothing...
There isn't really a job. I just wanted to talk to you.
Well, let's say the job was getting you here.
Right, then hand over the fee. Job's done, so I'm heading back.
W-Wait! Change of plans! The job includes hearing me out!
Aw, there goes my easy payday. You really can't make up your mind, can you?
So what's this about? Don't tell me you want me to become your subject again.
Ugh... Well... something like that.
Seriously? Why make me come all the way here just to hear the same thing you always say...?

Oh, are you hiring me to be your subject?
Because that, I could do.

My hourly rate's pretty steep, though.
What's your budget?
I don't want you sticking around just because I'm paying you!
Says the one who paid me to come here.
*Sigh*... You're really not holding back today.
I never hold back. That's part of my charm, isn't it?

Everything in life is give-and-take.
Well, if you let me sit in that chair, I might just hear you out.
...Fine. Come over and sit down.
Hmm... Nice and warm. I can still feel your body heat.

W-What are you talking about?! My warmth...?!
It's just a warm chair!

It feels way too warm for that...
Wait... the seat isn't wet, is it?

Of course not!
Stop joking around and listen to me!

You look uncomfortable standing there.
Come sit down so we can talk.

Isn't it a little cramped for two?
There are plenty of other seats.

Oh, take a hint.
I'm telling you to sit on my lap.
W-Why on earth would I sit there...

Come on, here's your chance.
Don't you want to try it?
Sit here and you can feel how warm I am for yourself.

No thanks!
Get a grip and get out of that chair!
Like I'd take orders from you... Whoa!!
Oof... What the heck just happened?

Yeah, what gives? Sitting right on top of someone like that.
Where are your manners?!
Well now, looks like we need to teach this guy a lesson.
Did you... undo your spell...?

Spell?
What are you talking about?

Don't try to play dumb now!
Think about what you just did!!

Hmph. Nothing to do with me.
Hey, you! If you're going to fight, take it outside. I don't want to clean up after you.

We don't want our favorite bar destroyed either.
Hey! Step outside!

Guh...
Just you wait till next time!
Hold it right there!!!

chat.t: You've got time, right?

o: I'm busy.

chat.t: Oh, please. I know what you're doing.
You're just lying around reading manga.

o: Heh. Shows what you know.
I'm reading pinup magazines, not manga.

chat.t: That still means you have time!
Anyway, come back to Bloody Mary.

o: I told you, I'm busy.
If you need something, you come to me.

chat.t: Oh, you...!!
Fine, I'll come over. Just pick a place.

o: Good. I never turn down a guest.
Let's meet in front of DD TOWN Station.

chat.t: So you weren't even trying when you set those high scores.
You set a score just high enough to tempt someone, then swoop in and beat them again...
You get your kicks out of that?!

o: A king doesn't have to go all out every time, right?
You have to know when to hold back and conserve your energy.
If a king takes every challenger seriously, he'll be the one to tire out first.

chat.t: Don't try to sugarcoat it.

o: Why do you think you always end up dancing to my tune?
Because you always try to tackle everything head-on.

chat.t: Ugh...

o: So try to relax a little next time you come see me.

lines.t: DD TOWN
Humanitas is nothing like Vermont. No dignity, no sense of order... just chaos.
How on earth do you live in a place like this?

You get used to it.
You would too.
Anyway, why did you call me over here?
I was thinking things over in my room, and I realized I'd gotten things backwards.

Before I can win you over as a subject,
I need to show you what makes me a queen.
So today, I'll show you just how great I am!
Oh, really? How?

You must have your own idea of what makes a queen.
I'll show you that I fit the bill!
So you're saying you'll do whatever I tell you?

Ugh... What's with that look?
I said within reason!
I won't do anything unbecoming of a queen.
Do you really think I'd do something ridiculous just because you asked?
Well, then, how about a little test to start?
DD STATION

Where are we...? It's so noisy and crowded...
It's like a market. Hardly a place for a queen.
What are you talking about? This is the perfect place to prove you're royalty.
People battle it out for the top spot here. The crown changes hands several times a day.
What? Here...? How?

It's all about the high scores.
Take the top spot and everyone will be staring at your name in envy.

Try that one.
You just press a button to stack blocks as high as you can. Even a beginner can get the hang of it.
What's the point of becoming queen of an easy game?
Well, that high score hasn't been beaten in months.
And yours truly is the one who set that record.

Hehe, now I get it.
If I beat you, the king of this game, you'll finally acknowledge me?

Now you're getting it.
Pretty simple, right?

Fine. Hurry up and teach me how to play.
I'll show you what I'm made of!
I explained the controls to Isabel.

Ugh... What?!
Why is it collapsing?!

You tilted it too far to the right.
I told you to keep it balanced.

I know! I know!
The blocks aren't falling where I want them to!
Sounds like you need more practice.

Ugh... This is so frustrating! But I can do this!
I'll beat you and become queen!
Well, I'm gonna go play some other games. Keep at it.
A moment later...
What's with all these people...? Don't tell me...

Heh, there you are.
Take a look! Your old score doesn't even come close!
Hehe. I'm the queen of this game now!
Well, look at you. You've been busy.

Huh? What are you doing?
Hey! What do you think you're doing?!
Ascending to the throne.
Isabel's record was shattered in an instant.
All those hours of effort, gone just like that...!!!!

chat.t: What do you think I'm lacking as a queen?

o: Territory
Subjects
A kingdom

chat.t: Not all that other stuff!
I mean the qualities I need as a queen!

o: I can't tell you that for free.

chat.t: Ugh...
Fine. I'll hire you.
Tell me what I'm lacking.

o: Now we're talking.
You've left a bruise!
That's going on your bill!

chat.t: You brought that on yourself.
You didn't do your job properly.

o: I did my best!
You just didn't like the result.
Booo! Worst client ever!!
You can't just hit people because you don't like the result.

chat.t: Fine! I'll pay, alright?!
In return, you owe me half off next time.

o: You've got all that money and you're still this stingy.
Wait, you're planning to hire me again?

chat.t: Who knows?

lines.t: Bloody Mary
It's quiet today.
Well, that's because we haven't opened for business yet.
So tell me what I'm missing before we open, will you?
Gonna put it to use right away?
Ngh... Well, you're half right.
I can see right through you.
Not that your outfit usually leaves much to the imagination.
So, what am I lacking as a queen?
Basically, you're trying too hard to be the perfect queen.
A little vulnerability makes you more human. Add some charisma, and people can't help being drawn to you.
Flaws...? No amount of charisma will help if I show weakness! No one would take me seriously as a queen!
Is that so? Then keep doing what you're doing.
Ugh... What should I do then...?
That's it. That's the side of you people need to see.
Being commanding is fine, but you need to make people want to be around you, too.
I still don't get it... Can you give me an example?
That's what I'm going to teach you.
You're gonna do as I say, right?
If it'll help me become a better queen, absolutely!
First, let's find somewhere we can be alone.
Bloody Mary
Perfect. Keep making that face and you'll win them over every time.
You'll have more subjects than you know what to do with!
Ngh...
Why so quiet? Time to put it into practice. Show me what you've got!
I can't let people see me like this!!!
There's no way I'm showing anyone!!
You showed me just fine.
That's because you—!! Ugh...
Forget it! Forget everything!! Forget all of it and get out of here!!
Aaah! Don't hit me for real! I'm fragile!

chat.t: I've got another job for you.
You remember it's half price this time, right?

o: I don't recall.

chat.t: It's right there in the chat history!
Don't try to back out now!

o: *Sigh*... I can't believe you're hiring me again.
What's up?

chat.t: Come shopping for ingredients with me.

o: What queen goes shopping in person?

chat.t: I need to see the ingredients for myself to know they're any good.

o: You sound like a hotel head chef.
Where should I go?

chat.t: Isabel shared a location.
Let's meet here.
Are you really going to buy it?

o: That price is a total rip-off.

chat.t: My perfume is worth that much.
If nobody bought it, they wouldn't sell it at that price.

o: There are actually people who spend that much money on perfume?

chat.t: If you try it yourself, you'll change your mind.

o: Then give me one.

chat.t: I'll give you one if you agree to become my subject.

o: I knew you would say that!

chat.t: If you can't buy it, I'll let you smell it once I finish making it.

o: I'm holding you to that!

chat.t: A queen never goes back on her word.

lines.t: Magic Street
So what did you come all the way here to buy?
Perfume ingredients. I'm starting to run low on spending money.

A true queen knows how to manage her money.
Plan ahead, and the treasury won't run dry.

You don't even have land or subjects.
Where did all the money you saved before go?
Let's call it the cost of keeping up royal appearances... *Sigh*.
And you never know when a good opportunity might pop up, so you have to be prepared.

What if the perfect property comes up for sale,
and I don't have the money? Just thinking about it hurts.
If only I hadn't had to spend so much lately...

Why are you staring at me?
Anyone would think I ripped you off.
Hey, I earned every penny.
Even though it feels like nothing went the way I wanted...

You did work hard to help me, though.
I don't regret paying you.
Didn't expect you to admit that so easily.
A queen must acknowledge effort, regardless of a person's ability.

Did you
just call me useless?
Take it however you like.
Anyway, here's the shopping list.
Didn't you say you needed to see the ingredients for yourself?
And I will, once you've bought them.
Just ask for what's on the list and buy it.
Umm... Tail of the Venomous Dragon, Golden Egg of the Great Sky God, Blue Crystal Infused with the Earth's Essence...
Are you... in your dramatic teenage phase or something?

I am not! Those are the ingredient names.
Don't get a single syllable wrong!
*Sigh*... Fine. I'll play along.
Hey, I need to buy a few things.
Of course! What are you looking for?
I'll take a Tail of the Venomous Dragon, a Golden Egg of the Great Sky God, and a Blue Crystal Infused with the Earth's Essence.
Oh! You mean a Venom Dragon's Tail, a Gryphon Egg, and Frost Herb, right?
Huh? Didn't you hear my order?
A Tail of the Venomous Dragon, a Golden Egg of the Great Sky God, and a Blue Crystal Infused with the Earth's Essence, right?

Hmm... I'm pretty sure that's what I said.
Did I get something wrong?

I haven't heard anyone call them that in ages...
Are you an old master who's somehow become young again?
It's just... those names fell out of use ages ago. You only see them in old books now.

Isabel!!! You said I had to order like this!
Did you trick me?!
Pfft. What's wrong, old man? Careful, you'll send your blood pressure through the roof.
Hmm... These all look good. We'll take them.
Yes! Thank you so much!!
Was this payback? You just wanted to make me look stupid?
Heh, of course not. People in this trade don't take kindly to outsiders...
If you use common names, they think you're an amateur and give you low-quality goods.
Besides, I wanted to see you say those names with a straight face.
Though I didn't expect you'd actually get called an old man.
*Sigh*... Alright. At least you're honest. That makes it a little less annoying.
You're making perfume out of those? They smell pretty awful.
That's where I come in. I draw out the good scents.
I simmer the ingredients properly, add my bodily fluids, and...
Hold on, stop!!!!! You add WHAT?!
My bodily fluids. Why, what's wrong?
I'll buy it!! I'm buying every last one!! How much is it?!

Hmm...? You're buying it?
I doubt you can afford it.
The price Isabel quoted me was slightly more than half a year's worth of living expenses.

chat.t: The perfume's ready. Want to come try it?

o: I'm coming over right now!!

chat.t: Heh, I had a feeling you would.

o: This isn't just an excuse to get me over there and ask for something, is it?

chat.t: I'm not that petty.
Think of it as a test run before I start selling it.

o: I'm running straight to Bloody Mary right now, so wait for me!

chat.t: Now that it's come to this, I'll never give up.
Someday I'll make you mine and force you to kneel before me.

o: Uh-huh, sure, good luck with that.

lines.t: Bloody Mary
What the? Why isn't she here? Did she run away?
Who says I ran away?
Whoa! Where did you come from? You scared me.
I've been getting everything ready.
Come on, why go through all that prep? What if I hadn't come?
You come running whenever a pretty woman calls, don't you? Of course you'd come when I asked.
*Sigh*... You really know you're a knockout, don't you? So, where's the perfume?
You really are impatient.
Well? Doesn't it smell amazing?
Mmm... So sweet... feels so good... the world is slowly...
Wait a second... Is this...?
Don't overthink it.
Now, shall we go to my room?
Bloody Mary
Ah, that was fun. I completely lost track of time.
Welcome to the kingdom, my subject. Did you enjoy yourself?
Let me know what you want. I said I'd grant your wish, and I meant it.
Oh, I've actually decided already.
Already? You only get one wish. Are you sure you want to use it so soon?
I've thought it through. You'd better keep your promise.
Ugh... What exactly are you going to ask me for...?

Well, a promise is a promise. Go on!
As queen, I'll grant my first subject whatever he wishes.
Alright, my wish is... to renounce my citizenship!
Huh... Wh... WHAT?!!!!
You're saying you don't want to be my subject anymore?! No! Absolutely not!!
Wait, what about the perfume?! Did my power not work on you again?!
It hasn't worked up until now, so why would it work now?
Sure, it made me feel good and a little woozy. That was it.
Anyway, didn't you say you'd grant whatever I wanted? Why not this?
Of course you can't! Then you wouldn't be my subject anymore!
Think about it again. There might be something even better than that.
No, I'm leaving this kingdom. It's far too small to contain me.
There's a whole wide world out there waiting for me.
You're not going back on your word, are you? I can't serve a queen who lies.
Which means... no matter what I choose, you're going to leave.
Heh, you catch on fast.

Your choice. Will you let me go?
Or will you break your word as queen and watch me leave anyway?
*Sigh*... Alright. You have my permission to leave.
Thank you, Your Majesty.
Ugh... I'm so mad!! That was your plan all along!
Who knows? Try a little harder to win me over and things might turn out differently.
How much harder am I supposed to try?!
E... Even my... first time...
What was that? I couldn't hear you.
Forget it! Just go! Leave! Stop making me feel so miserable!
